class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Create &amp; manage schedules for tasks in Gemini Spark</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>You can put your workflows on autopilot by adding schedules to your tasks. A schedule acts as the automated trigger for a task, telling Gemini Spark exactly when to step in and execute your instructions. You can set these triggers based on time intervals, like every Monday morning, or based on certain conditions, like when an email arrives in your inbox.</p>

<p>To get started, you can schedule a task conversationally with Gemini in a task thread or in a Live chat. Just describe what you want Gemini Spark to do and when to do it. You can also visit the Schedules page to create it yourself.</p>
</div>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> This article covers schedules for tasks in Spark. <a href="/gemini/answer/16316416" rel="noopener">Scheduled actions</a> are a separate feature that automates certain actions in Gemini chats.</p>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use Gemini Spark, you must:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Be 18 or over</strong>.</li>
  <li><strong>Sign in to the Gemini app with a personal Google Account.</strong> For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in with a work or school Google Account. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Have a Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription.</strong> <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">Learn how to upgrade</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Have <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> on</strong>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> For now, Gemini Spark is:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Available wherever Gemini Apps are supported, except in the European Economic Area, Nigeria, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.</li>
  <li>Only available in the Gemini mobile app, the Gemini app on Mac, and the Gemini web app at <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="schedule_types">Types of schedules</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini currently supports three types of schedules.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Time-based:</strong> schedule tasks to run once, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

    <ul>
      <li>For example: “Every day at 7 AM, look through my emails, calendar, and Drive, and let me know what to prioritize for the day”</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Gmail monitors:</strong> schedule tasks to run when you receive an email that satisfies a Gmail filter.
    <ul>
      <li>For example: “Whenever I receive an email from my manager with an action item for me, help me address the action item and draft a reply.”</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Topic monitors:</strong> monitor topics across news, finance, sports, local events, and more, and schedule tasks to run in response to specific events.
    <ul>
      <li>For example: “Whenever a new food popup is announced in my city, email me the details and suggest a time on my calendar to check it out.”</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<p>While Gemini has improved at monitoring and responding to events more quickly, monitors are still not ideal for tracking fast-moving data or performing time-critical tasks like “Let me know when tickets go on sale immediately so I can buy it.”</p>
</div>

<p><a href="#schedules_timezones" rel="noopener">Learn how time-based schedules work with time zones</a>.</p>

<gkms-context-selector id="17103302"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="create_schedule">Create a schedule</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="schedule_convo" name="schedule_convo">Create a schedule conversationally</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.
    <ul>
      <li>On a Mac, you can also open the Gemini app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>On the sidebar, click Switch to Spark <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF">.</li>
  <li>In the text box, describe the task you want to schedule.
    <ul>
      <li>For example:
        <ul>
          <li>“Every day at 7 AM, look through my emails, calendar, and Drive, and let me know what to prioritize for the day.”</li>
          <li>“Whenever I receive an email from my manager with an action item for me, help me address the action item and draft a reply.”</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li>To specify an existing skill to use, enter <code>/</code>, start typing the skill name, and select the skill. If it’s off, you can turn it on. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094296" rel="noopener">Learn more about skills</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="schedule_template" name="schedule_template">Create a time–based schedule using a blank template</a>

<div>
  <p>The option to create a schedule manually is only available for time-based schedules.</p>

  <div class="no-margin"><div>
  <ol>
    <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.
      <ul>
        <li>On a Mac, you can also open the Gemini app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
      </ul>
    </li>
    <li>On the sidebar, click Switch to Spark <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Schedules</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oftmkdyvZtepzp-kHua-DJTarxrY5mbAvMJyvbQ5sgsrCztSBT0toTWGJ6Ig1fC2byw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oftmkdyvZtepzp-kHua-DJTarxrY5mbAvMJyvbQ5sgsrCztSBT0toTWGJ6Ig1fC2byw">.</li>
    <li>On the Schedules page, click <strong>Create manually</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/76c-HFRtqVOLRF4si3ZZ7JxrkyuN6_wGcUizgOiC54u74tPM4MTYilfm_01SOu2DrxdN=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/76c-HFRtqVOLRF4si3ZZ7JxrkyuN6_wGcUizgOiC54u74tPM4MTYilfm_01SOu2DrxdN">.</li>
    <li>Enter a name for the schedule.</li>
    <li>Select when you want the task to run.</li>
    <li>Enter the instructions for the task.
      <ul>
        <li>To specify an existing skill to use, enter <code>/</code>, start typing the skill name, and select the skill. If it’s off, you can turn it on. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094296" rel="noopener">Learn more about skills</a>.</li>
      </ul>
    </li>
    <li>When you’re done, at the top, click <strong>Create</strong>. This saves the schedule to your “Ongoing” list.</li>
  </ol>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="fix_a_problem">Fix a problem</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="wont_work" name="wont_work">I can’t create or turn on a schedule</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>There are a few reasons why you might not be able to create or turn on a schedule.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Active schedules limit reached:</strong> The current limit for how many active schedules you can have in Gemini Spark is 50. To create or resume a schedule after reaching this limit, first pause or delete an existing one.</li>
  <li><strong>Completed schedule:</strong> You cannot edit or resume a schedule after it’s marked as complete. You can only delete it.</li>
  <li><strong>Missing required fields:</strong> If you’re creating a schedule from a template but can’t select “Create,” make sure to fill out all sections: the schedule’s name, when it should run, and instructions for the task.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="not_run" name="not_run">Why didn't my schedule run on time or run at all?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Here are some reasons that a schedule might not run:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Usage limit reached:</strong> Gemini Apps have compute-based usage limits that determine how much you can interact with Gemini tools and features. Schedules will not run if you have reached your limit at the time it was set to run. Other features may also be unavailable when you reach your usage limit. <a href="/gemini/answer/16275805" rel="noopener">Learn more about limits in Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Concurrent task limit reached:</strong> You can have at most 15 tasks running at a given time. A schedule will not run if there are already 15 tasks currently running.</li>
  <li><strong>Schedule run times vary:</strong> Scheduled tasks run times are approximate and may not run at the exact moment a time or event condition is met.</li>
  <li><strong>Delays during high traffic:</strong> When there’s a large increase in activity in Gemini Apps, scheduled tasks might be delayed.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="questions">Common questions</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><a class="zippy" id="task_schedule_skill" name="task_schedule_skill">What's the difference between a task, schedule, and skill?</a>
<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>To help you get the most out of Spark tasks, it’s helpful to understand the three building blocks that power its logic: tasks, schedules, and skills. Think of these as the what, when, and how.</p>

<p><strong>A task is your high-level goal.</strong> It represents a complete project or objective you want Gemini Spark to manage for you.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "Plan and manage my business trip to London."</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>A schedule lets you hand over tasks</strong> to Gemini Spark so they run automatically in the background. You tell Gemini what to do and when to do it. Tasks can be scheduled to run at a specific date and time or in response to an event.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "Every day at 8AM (condition), give me an update on AI news (task)"</li>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "When my flight is delayed (condition), notify me and propose an update to my itinerary (task)."</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Schedules in Gemini Spark are different from scheduled actions in Gemini chat. <a href="/gemini/answer/16316416" rel="noopener">Learn how to schedule actions in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>

<p><strong>A skill is a set of reusable instructions and additional context.</strong> It teaches Gemini how to do a specific task and what tools to use. You can specify the skill Gemini Spark should use for a task or a schedule’s action. Spark can also automatically use a skill when it’s relevant to a task.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> Using a "Travel Booking" skill and a "Gmail Writing" skill simultaneously to rebook a room and send a confirmation.</li>
</ul>

<p>In summary, you define the task (what you want), set the schedules (when it should happen), and provide the skills (how to do it) to complete the work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="downgrade_cancel_ultra" name="downgrade_cancel_ultra">What happens if I cancel or downgrade my Google AI subscription?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>If you cancel your Google AI subscription or downgrade to a subscription that doesn't support access to Gemini Spark, you will lose access to Gemini Spark, tasks, schedules, and skills. Your data is retained but some features are paused or disabled:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>In-progress Spark tasks</strong> will finish, but are not deleted.</li>
  <li><strong>Schedules</strong> will be paused, but not deleted.</li>
  <li><strong>Skills</strong> are turned off, but not deleted.</li>
</ul>

<p>To regain access and resume these features, you’ll need to upgrade or resubscribe to a Google AI subscription that supports Gemini Spark. <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage your Google AI subscription</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="spark_off" name="spark_off">What happens to my schedules if I turn off Gemini Spark?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>If you turn Gemini Spark off, any schedules you have will automatically pause.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="schedules_timezones" name="schedules_timezones">How do time-based schedules work if I change time zones?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark runs in the cloud instead of on your phone or computer. This means it keeps working even if your device is turned off.</p>

<p><strong>How schedules work across time zones</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Fixed time zones:</strong> When you create a time-based schedule (like a daily summary) in the Gemini app, it’s locked to the timezone of the location where it was created.</li>
  <li><strong>Travel:</strong> Your schedules will continue to run at the original scheduled time, even if you travel to a different timezone.</li>
  <li><strong>Updating schedules:</strong> If you move to a new location and want your routines to adjust to your new local time, simply ask Gemini to "edit the schedule based on my new timezone."</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

</ul>
